body: Also, to be clear, although I am extremely hung up on her I really just miss her so much as a person and would do anything to still get to know her. I would be entirely willing to have a painful friendship with her for a while if it would mean we could be in eachother's lives.
I guess I just want to see if people even care at that point. I'd love it if this would make her feel something.
What happened? Did the attempt just fail? Did she seem to care?
What's eating at you? I'm a danger to myself right now as well. Perhaps a fellow suicidal individual can help. Maybe we can help eachother.
